ache.title: Two Leonide builds means double the grind
ache.note: This guide splits Leonide into a tanky passive build and a charge-focused burst build for PvP and PvM. Builds are fun to theorycraft, but two builds quietly means twice the materials and twice the reasons to farm. Pick the one you enjoy and let the other stay a fun idea.
ache.tip: Choose one build you enjoy and stop there. Fun doesn’t need a second set of resources.
lines: one build is plenty. pinky promise
theorycraft for free, farm for fun only
he wanted both. of course he did

title: Character Guides: Leonide | Sword of Convallaria
excerpt: In this episode, I dive deep into the skills and builds of Leonide, a highly requested unit from the game Sword of Convallaria. I'll cover both the tanky passive build and the active charge-focused build, providing detailed explanations of each skill and how to maximize their effectiveness in both PvP and PvM scenarios. Additionally, I discuss the mechanics, talents, and strategies to turn Leonide into either a burst DPS or a sustained DPS. Join me as I break down everything you need to know...

videoData.title: Character Guides: Leonide | Sword of Convallaria

textData.text: In this episode, I dive deep into the skills and builds of Leonide, a highly requested unit from the game Sword of Convallaria. I'll cover both the tanky passive build and the active charge-focused build, providing detailed explanations of each skill and how to maximize their effectiveness in both PvP and PvM scenarios. Additionally, I discuss the mechanics, talents, and strategies to turn Leonide into either a burst DPS or a sustained DPS. Join me as I break down everything you need to know about this versatile and fun character!
